workshops.title: Gamify Your In-Class Live Quiz
workshops.audience: University instructors, teachers, and trainers familiar with traditional lecture delivery; limited experience with live quiz tools or gamification as a deliberate pedagogical technique
workshops.ilo: Design a single live-quiz question that connects a game mechanic to a specific learning outcome — so students retrieve and apply knowledge rather than guess.

workshops.title: The Most Effective Study Technique You're Probably Not Using
workshops.ilo: By the end of this workshop, participants will be able to use retrieval practice as a study method by recalling course content from memory without looking at notes, and identifying gaps to guide further study.

workshops.title: Calculate the Variance of a Sample
workshops.ilo: Calculate the variance of a small dataset by hand, following the three-step process: subtract the mean, square the differences, and average the squared values.
